feeds.title: Tie Dye Travels
feeds.description: Author Kat Robinson explores Arkansas and beyond, sharing authentic stories about food, destinations, culture and history with beautiful photography.

feeds.title: Simple Joyful Food
feeds.description: Covers articles on kitchen organization tips, foodie finds, meal planning and meal prepping, clean recipes with simple ingredients, by Lindi, who encourages food joy by focusing on simplicity tips and tricks.

feeds.title: AY Magazine » Food
feeds.description: AY magazine's Eat and Drink section that shows you places to eat in Little Rock. They simplify your decision by giving you a list of great downtown Little Rock restaurants that you can choose from. It is a premier general interest magazine that features people, places, food and culture.

feeds.title: Heather's Dish Blog
feeds.description: A food blog by Heather Disarro. She is a Wife, mom, fitness fanatic, coffee enthusiast, daughter of the King. Food + life blogger living in the Natural State who is passionate about living a life of love. This blog is her source of income and here she shares the nitty gritty behind it all.

feeds.title: The Mighty Rib
feeds.description: The Mighty Rid is a food blog established in March 2010 and inspired by a dining experience at the famous Oklahoma Joe's in Kansas City. Kevin is a teacher/writer living in Little Rock with his wife and two children. Writing and food have always been a major part of his life, so he figured starting a food blog was the way to go.

feeds.title: Arkansas Times » Dining
feeds.description: Dining reviews and smart, lively coverage of Arkansas restaurants, bars, chefs and food trends.

feeds.title: Jennifer Maune Blog » Recipes
feeds.description: Top Food blog and Home Chef, Jennifer Maune, shares hundreds of delicious, easy recipes and baking tips.

feeds.title: Planted in Arkansas
feeds.description: Get Dessert recipes, dinner recipes, breakfast recipes, potluck recipes, party food recipes from Arkansas food and lifestyle blogger, Amy. She is a wife, girl mom, plant mom, and junior high English as a Second Language (ESL) teacher. Born in Arkansas she is known for house plant addiction, bright colors, yummy food, and tendency to celebrate all things big and small.
